why: `break` leaves the innermost loop, and the checker only counts for/while bodies as loops — here there is nothing to leave. Crossing the workflow boundary is what `stop` exists for; mixing the two makes the control flow unreadable.
fix: use `workflow.stop(reason: …)` to end the workflow early
or move the `break` inside the loop it is meant to leave
